title: Claude and Unity for a few days.
author: cpKaktus
selftext: Here you see the small details I started with, to the very unfinished larger project. There is a 3.5 km × 1.6 km map outside of the building, waiting to be used. The large model in the end is downloaded and modded by Claude. I havent done shit, other than chatting with Claude and paste screenshots of how I want it. Mostly with Sonnet :)
